basics.description: **Enterprise Tier** — Full Microsoft Sentinel deployment with all solutions, connectors, UEBA, diagnostics, and analytics rules enabled. Provided by Softwerx.

basics.name: workspaceName
basics.label: Workspace Name
basics.toolTip: The Workspace name should include 4-63 letters, digits or '-'. The '-' shouldn't be the first or the last symbol.

constraints.validationMessage: Only alphanumeric characters are allowed, and the value must be 1-30 characters long.
Retention must be between 30 and 730 days.

basics.name: pricingTier
basics.label: Select pricing tier for Sentinel and Log Analytics
basics.toolTip: Visit [Azure Monitor Pricing page](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/monitor/) for more information.

options.text: Enterprise tier enables all settings by default. Review and adjust as needed for your environment.

elements.name: enableUeba
elements.label: Enable User Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA)? Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.
elements.toolTip: Enables UEBA entity provider sync. Only select 'Active Directory' if Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI) is already deployed and onboarded.

elements.name: identityProviders
elements.label: Select which Identity Providers will be synchronized with UEBA
elements.toolTip: Select the identity providers that you would like to enable for UEBA

elements.name: enableDiagnostics
elements.label: Enable Sentinel health diagnostics?
elements.toolTip: This will enable diagnostics settings for Analytics rules, Data Connectors and Automation rules.

options.text: Enterprise tier pre-selects all available Microsoft and Essentials solutions. Deselect any that are not applicable to your environment.

elements.name: enableSolutions1P
elements.label: Select Microsoft Content Hub solutions to install
elements.toolTip: Select the Microsoft solutions that you would like to install

options.text: Enterprise tier pre-selects all automatable connectors. CAUTION items (Entra ID IDP, Defender for Cloud Apps) are NOT pre-selected — only enable them if your tenant does NOT use the Microsoft Defender XDR portal.

elements.name: enableDataConnectors
elements.label: Select data connectors to onboard
elements.toolTip: Select the data connectors that you would like to enable

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Entra ID
allowedValues.description: Configures tenant-level diagnostic settings to forward sign-in, audit, and identity risk logs to Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Azure Activity
allowedValues.description: Ingest Azure subscription Activity logs into Sentinel via subscription-level diagnostic settings.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender XDR
allowedValues.description: Sync Microsoft Defender XDR incidents and alerts into Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams)
allowedValues.description: Ingest Office 365 activity logs from Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Teams.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
allowedValues.description: Ingest security alerts from Microsoft Defender for Cloud.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Entra ID Identity Protection (CAUTION)
allowedValues.description: WARNING: Do not select if your tenant uses Microsoft Defender XDR — configure via the Defender portal instead.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps (CAUTION)
allowedValues.description: WARNING: Do not select if your tenant manages Defender for Cloud Apps through the Microsoft Defender XDR portal.

allowedValues.label: Dynamics 365
allowedValues.description: Ingest Dynamics 365 activity logs into Sentinel.

elements.name: enableOngoingDiagnostics
elements.label: Enable Azure Policy for ongoing diagnostic settings enforcement
elements.toolTip: Creates Azure Policy assignments (deployIfNotExists) for each selected resource type. New resources are automatically configured. Requires Owner on subscription.

options.text: Enterprise tier pre-selects all diagnostic resource types. Deselect any that are not present in your subscription.

elements.name: enableDiagnosticPolicies
elements.label: Configure Azure Diagnostics for existing resources
elements.toolTip: Diagnostic settings will be configured on all matching resources found in your subscription at deployment time.

allowedValues.label: Azure Key Vault
allowedValues.description: Enables AuditEvent diagnostic logs on all Key Vaults in the subscription.

allowedValues.label: Azure Network Security Groups
allowedValues.description: Enables NetworkSecurityGroupEvent and NetworkSecurityGroupRuleCounter logs on all NSGs.

allowedValues.label: Azure Storage Accounts
allowedValues.description: Enables StorageRead, StorageWrite and StorageDelete logs on all Storage Accounts.

allowedValues.label: Azure SQL Databases
allowedValues.description: Enables SQLSecurityAuditEvents, SQLInsights, Errors, Timeouts, Blocks and Deadlocks logs on all SQL Databases.

allowedValues.label: Azure Firewall
allowedValues.description: Enables AzureFirewallApplicationRule, AzureFirewallNetworkRule, AzureFirewallDnsProxy, and AzureFirewallThreatIntel logs on all Azure Firewalls.

allowedValues.label: Azure Application Gateway (WAF)
allowedValues.description: Enables ApplicationGatewayAccessLog, ApplicationGatewayPerformanceLog, and ApplicationGatewayFirewallLog on all Application Gateways.

options.text: Enterprise tier enables analytics rules at High, Medium, and Low severity by default.

elements.name: enableScheduledAlerts
elements.label: Enable Scheduled alert rules for selected Content Hub solutions and Data Connectors?
elements.toolTip: Select to enable Scheduled and NRT analytics rules for the solutions and connectors selected in the previous tabs

elements.name: severityLevels
elements.label: Select the severity of the rules to enable
elements.toolTip: Select the severity levels of the analytics rules to enable
